title: A difference
description: A difference that a comparison of two versions found in one occurrence, in version 1 of the API. A later minor change can add members, so a client ignores the members it does not know.

occurrenceKind.description: The kind of its occurrence. For example, article.

num.description: The label of its occurrence as printed. For example, (a). Empty if it has none.

parent.description: The eId of the occurrence that it is in. Null for an outermost occurrence.

section.description: The eId of the occurrence with a title that it is in, as the outline nests them.

tags.description: The tags of the later text: which acts gave the occurrence its form, and how.

earlierTags.description: The tags of the earlier text.

amendments.description: The amendments that Cellar records at the occurrence between the two versions.

before.description: The plain text of the occurrence before the change.

after.description: The plain text of the occurrence after the change.

runs.description: The runs of words, in order. The text before is the runs that are not insert. The text after is the runs that are not delete. A line feed ends each paragraph, and each number and heading of an occurrence in the occurrence, except the last.

shown.description: The occurrence, with its edits. In its HTML, inserted words are in ins and deleted words are in del. Its plain text is the text after the change.

act.description: The CELEX number of the amending act.

in.description: The eId of the occurrence that the act gave its form as a whole. Null for a tag of the occurrence itself.

amendment.description: An amendment that Cellar records at an occurrence.

act.description: The CELEX number of the amending act.

cited.description: How the Official Journal cites the amending act. For example, 2019/103.

location.description: Where it acts, as Cellar codes it.

role.description: What it did. For example, replacement.

from.description: The day from which it applies, as Cellar records it. Null if Cellar has none.

run.description: A run of words, and what the comparison found of it.

op.description: equal: the run is in both versions. insert: only in the later version. delete: only in the earlier version.
